claims.location: comment[data file] and source name, all 32 rows
claims.value: 32 Thermo .raw acquisitions from 16 biological preparations, each measured by Normal and Fast technical methods
claims.evidence: Every PRIDE raw filename matches one of C-C, C-UV, RF-UV, RV-UV; R1–R4 mark four biological preparations per group, and b suffix marks the Fast second technical acquisition per PRIDE protocol.
PRIDE organism and publication Methods state Xenopus laevis sperm chromatin incubated in egg extract.

claims.location: characteristics[UV-C treatment] and factor value[UV-C treatment], all rows
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample-processing protocol states 2,000 J/m2 UV-C on sperm chromatin or untreated control; C-C files are untreated, all -UV files treated.

claims.location: characteristics[egg extract depletion] and factor value[egg extract depletion], all rows
claims.value: mock-depleted, RFWD3-depleted or REV1-depleted non-licensing egg extract
claims.evidence: PRIDE and publication describe mock, RFWD3 and REV1 depletion; deposited raw-file group codes C-C, C-UV, RF-UV and RV-UV distinguish the conditions.
PRIDE sample-processing protocol names the instrument and HCD fragmentation with precursor selection; the publication describes label-free MS.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], two repeated columns, all rows
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol explicitly states first LysC for 2.5 hours then trypsin overnight. The builder emitted one cleavage column, so the deterministic generator expands the source-table pipe-separated values to two repeated columns in physical order.

limitations: PRIDE and publication do not provide the exact precursor and fragment search mass tolerances or explicit modification search settings, so these optional/recommended parameters are omitted.
The sample is a mixture of sperm chromatin and egg extract; organism part, cell type, developmental stage and sex are left not available rather than assigning a single component.
The reconcile helper reads duplicate cleavage headers as one field and reports an incomplete digest even though the validated SDRF contains both Lys-C and Trypsin columns.
